title: Uh Oh Canada
summary:
Price drop may slow down oil production growth
On Tuesday, June 9, the Canadian Association of Petroleum Producers (CAPP) released their latest annual forecast titled "Crude Oil - Forecast, Markets & Transportation". Increased global oil supplies have resulted in lower oil prices. This is challenging the economics of new projects and reducing the capital expenditure plans of the major Canadian producers.
